newsitem.title: JAPAN: Desirable dlr-yen rate 110-120 yen - JAMA.
newsitem.headline: Desirable dlr-yen rate 110-120 yen - JAMA.

text.p: Japan Automobile Manufacturers Association (JAMA) chairman Yoshifumi Tsuji told a news conference on Thursday that the desirable dollar-yen rate for the Japanese car industry is between 110 yen and 120 yen.
"We feel that between 110 and 120 yen is a very good level for the automobile industry," he said.
He also said that domestic car sales were likely to start to decline significantly in May due to the increase in the sales tax to five percent from the previous three percent on April 1.
He said the negative aspects for the industry of the weaker yen would likely show up in vehicle manufacturers' results for this fiscal year ending on March 31, 1998.
He said the weaker yen meant higher utility charges and higher costs for materials such as steel.
